$schema-note: Defines one complete site style. The file supplies two color palettes, four font roles, shape, texture, density, a default illustration set, and curated options.
$palette-note: Color channels use [r, g, b] numbers. The generator writes RGB triples. The dark palette is authored separately. Institutional uses the highest contrast targets among the six styles.
$first-class-note: All six styles are complete and supported. Each has one default configuration. scripts/build-preset-catalog.cjs defines the picker order.
$default-note: A new deployment starts with Institutional because it uses the simplest layout and the strongest accessibility defaults. Clients can select any other style.
label: Institutional
summary: A formal, accessible layout with clear hierarchy, restrained decoration, and large control targets.
bestFor: Use this style for universities, public agencies, and organizations with formal accessibility requirements.
$palette-words-light: document off-white, statute near-black, restrained civic blue, form-grey rule, hearing-room slate, plain caution amber, plain confirm green, record grey
$palette-words-dark: evening-office neutral, high-contrast bone text, retuned civic blue, lamp-grey rule, night slate, caution amber held bright, confirm green held bright, archive grey
$font-note: Uses Merriweather for headings, Public Sans for body text and labels, and IBM Plex Mono for times, room codes, and identifiers.
$tokens-note: Remaps existing tier 2 and tier 3 tokens. The schedule uses comfortable vertical padding and the data font for folio text. The definition list widens its term column for the long labels a public notice carries. The pull quote keeps the plain ruled form with a rule at its inline start, like a quoted minute. A table takes the full hairline grid, like a posted schedule. The timeline, the progress bar and the notice bar keep the contract defaults. The other wave 2 devices (the avatar, the dropzone, the repeater, the count, the legend, the state marker, the byline) keep the contract defaults: a public notice adds no treatment of its own.

choices.label: Merriweather
choices.why: Uses the standard USWDS serif and sans pairing. It gives headings more weight while Public Sans keeps body text and controls clear.

choices.label: Source Serif 4
choices.why: Uses a lighter serif for headings. It suits universities and cultural organizations that need a less formal tone.

choices.label: Public Sans bold
choices.why: Uses one sans-serif family for headings, body text, labels, and data. This is the simplest type hierarchy.

choices.label: Institutional letterhead
choices.why: Places the event name first and the organization line below it. Use it for a formal single-organization event.

choices.label: Two-part lockup
choices.why: Places the logo at the left and the event details at the right. A vertical rule separates the two parts.

choices.label: Compact standing head
choices.why: Reduces the header size on content-heavy pages so the page title appears sooner.

choices.label: Posted agenda
choices.why: Uses fixed columns, hairline row rules, and tabular figures. It keeps the same order at each screen width.

choices.label: Numbered agenda
choices.why: Adds plain sequence numbers to the schedule. The numbers are not zero-padded.

longReadOpening.label: Long read opening
longReadOpening.prompt: Choose how the first paragraph of a Long read page opens.

choices.label: Drop cap
choices.why: Enlarges the first letter of the first paragraph to the height of three lines, in the heading typeface.

choices.label: Standfirst
choices.why: Sets the first paragraph at the lead size, as a summary of the page.

choices.label: Plain
choices.why: Keeps the first paragraph at body size with no drop cap.

quote.label: Quote device
quote.prompt: Choose how a quoted sentence is set.

choices.label: Ruled minute
choices.why: Sets the quote between two hairlines with a strong rule at its start, like a quoted minute.

choices.label: Plain rules
choices.why: Sets the quote between two hairlines with no side rule.

directory.label: Directory style
directory.prompt: Choose how the speaker shelf and the attendee index are set.

choices.label: Ruled entries
choices.why: Sets square portraits and rules each entry at the hairline.

choices.label: Portrait plates
choices.why: Sets taller portraits on the alternate ground and gives each index row more room.

sectionBoundary.label: Section boundary
sectionBoundary.prompt: Choose how a section heading is ruled and labelled.

choices.label: Rule and folio
choices.why: Draws the section rule with the folio at the far end of the heading line.

choices.label: Rule only
choices.why: Draws the section rule and hides the folio beside the heading.

choices.label: Folio in the margin
choices.why: Places the folio where the margin column opens beside the text measure on wide screens. On narrow screens it returns to the end of the line.

tableRules.label: Table rules
tableRules.prompt: Choose how a table is ruled.

choices.label: Hairline rows
choices.why: Rules the rows and the head at the hairline and draws no column rules.

choices.label: Ruled head
choices.why: Closes the head with a strong rule and rules the rows at the hairline, with no column rules.

choices.label: Full grid
choices.why: Rules the rows and the columns at the hairline, with the head closed at the width the style sets.
